H. Rider Haggard, When the World Shook.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/h-rider-haggard/when-the-world-shook

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- H. Rider Haggard, an annotator and author, died 1925.

First publication of the text used: 1919 (SE colophon: 'When the World Shook was published in 1919 by H. Rider Haggard.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1919. The edition's own statement of rights (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon (quoted above): publication year 1919.
- Wikidata Q237196 (H. Rider Haggard), P570 = 1925-05-14
